ambient_events: Nothing lives in this run, and nothing has for a while. It is the quietest tunnel you have been in down here.
A chalked shape on the wall, a leaf or a flame, with a time under it.
The rungs of the ladder here have been wire-brushed bright. Somebody uses them.
description: The tunnel beneath Kessler Street carries the quiet waste of the blocks above: grey water, lost things, the occasional startled scurry at the edge of your light.
name: Drain Junction
